note: L'Atelier du Peintre (B04) seen front-on from the Place du Village: the same palette-shaped white cottage as in the square view (paint-well portholes, thumb-hole knob, blank board over the dark glazed double door, slate roof, stone chimney with the paintbrush tip, dry-stone wall and potted plants). Ground floor + loft under the palette gable. Inside walk (a loop): R_colors_01 -> arch -> R_colors_02 -> stairs up -> R_shapes_02 -> blue door -> R_shapes_03 -> spiral stair down -> R_colors_01 -> glazed door -> out here.
